_comment: Single source for values shared by Java, Python and Node. Each language has a test that compares its constants with this file. Change the value here first, then in every language.

errorMessageByCode.AUTHENTICATION_FAILED: Sejong University portal authentication failed. Check the student ID and password.
errorMessageByCode.CONNECTION_FAILED: Cannot connect to the Sejong University portal.
errorMessageByCode.CONNECTION_TIMEOUT: Connection to the Sejong University portal timed out.
errorMessageByCode.SESSION_ERROR: An error occurred while handling the portal session.
errorMessageByCode.ACCOUNT_LOCKED: The portal account is locked after too many wrong passwords. Reset the password at https://portal.sejong.ac.kr/jsp/inquiry/pwinquiry.jsp
errorMessageByCode.ACCOUNT_UNAVAILABLE: The portal account cannot sign in (use period ended or blocked by the administrator).
